calls.statement:
SELECT s.format,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       COUNT(*) AS line_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.store_key)) AS receipt_store_pairs,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH mine AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_before
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4
  GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(receipts) AS receipts, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS net_before
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS stores, SUM(m.receipts) AS my_receipts, SUM(c.receipts) AS ctl_receipts,
       SUM(m.net_before) AS my_net, SUM(c.net_before) AS ctl_net,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.receipts<>c.receipts OR abs(m.net_before-c.net_before)>0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stores_differing
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c USING (store_id)

calls.statement:
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.format, count(DISTINCT s.store_key) AS versions, count(DISTINCT cs.format) AS formats_over_time,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff_lines, sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND s.store_id<900
GROUP BY 1,2,3
HAVING count(DISTINCT cs.format)>1 OR sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0
